stem: In the figure, line \(\ell\) is parallel to line \(m\). What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle labeled \((3x - 10)^{\circ}\)?
solution: The two labeled angles lie between the parallel lines on opposite sides of the transversal, so they are alternate interior angles and are equal.

explanation.A: Incorrect. 20 is the value of \(x\), not the measure of the angle.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This comes from setting the two angles supplementary (\(4x + 20 = 180\), \(x = 40\)); alternate interior angles are equal.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(180 - 50\), the angle next to the one asked for.

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert P['C'][1]==P['D'][1] and P['E'][1]==P['F'][1]
x=symbols('x')
xs=solve(Eq(3*x-10,x+30),x)[0]
ans=3*xs-10
assert abs(ang('F','Q','P')-(xs+30))<0.1 and abs(ang('C','P','Q')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==50
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
assert value(choices['B'])==3*solve(Eq((3*x-10)+(x+30),180),x)[0]-10
